caption: The drawing contains four spoons arranged side by side in a horizontal row on a plain, light-colored background. The spoon on the far left and the spoon second from the left have small, narrow bowls and similarly shaped handles, which are rectangular with a rounded end and feature a heart-shaped notch at the top. The handles are engraved with the marking "S.&C.S." The two spoons on the right are larger, with the second from the right being the largest; it also has a wide, deep bowl and the same style of handle with a heart-shaped notch and the marking "S.&C.S." The spoon on the far right is slightly smaller in size but has a similar overall shape to the largest spoon. The drawing is rendered primarily in gray tones, with some subtle areas of shading and highlights to indicate the reflective surface of the metal. The drawing uses fine lines and delicate washes to define the shapes and contours of the spoons.
title: Bishop Hill: Small Spoon
